operations.title: Scan Events
operations.description: Latest-state SSE snapshots; reconnect after 30 seconds, no replay guarantee.

operations.title: Scan Cancel
operations.description: Fence queued/running work; active tools stop at a phase boundary or timeout.

operations.title: Repository Remediation
operations.description:
Group finding observations, not deduplicated vulnerabilities or verified fixes.

Counts use current analyst dispositions. Observation timestamps do not imply
resolution timestamps or independently verified remediation.

operations.title: Review Queue
operations.description: List tenant document metadata; pending, unexpired documents are the default review queue.

operations.title: Place Hold
operations.description: Preserve a tenant document without extending content access; exact request replays are idempotent.

operations.title: List Holds
operations.description: Return bounded, audited preservation history without object paths or OCR content.

operations.title: Release Hold
operations.description: Release once through a different HR reviewer; conflicting decisions return 409.

operations.title: Risk Evidence
operations.description: Versioned projection of retained evidence, not a rewrite of original risk.

operations.title: My Organizations
operations.description:
Discover only this authenticated account's active organization memberships.

No organization header or MFA step-up is required for this limited metadata.
Actual organization access continues to require the existing fresh-authority
and privileged-MFA checks. Follow next_cursor even if a page has no items.

operations.title: Lifecycle Compensation
operations.description: Propose an inverse plan; execution still needs fresh independent approval.

operations.title: Stream
operations.description:
SSE state/heartbeat/result/error. Result is a complete InsightOutput, never partial model JSON.

POST once; no automatic reconnect, replay or regeneration after disconnect.
Generation is advisory and uses the same minimized context and quota policy as JSON APIs.

operations.title: Request
operations.description: Admit one bounded monthly provider read. Request keys are actor/period-bound and replay without another provider call. AWS queries may incur charges. Up to three pending and twenty daily collections per organization; failed/ambiguous reads require an explicit new request key.

operations.title: Report
operations.description: Return one immutable account-filtered observation report. Amounts include signed adjustments and separate currency totals. This is not an invoice and does not post into manual costs.

operations.title: Posture Status
operations.description: Security-authorized local configuration status; never probes AWS or reveals role credentials.

operations.title: Billing Status
operations.description: Finance-authorized local setup status; configured is explicitly unverified.

operations.title: Billing Sample
operations.description: Explicit development-only sample; never a fallback or a stored/live billing report.

limitation.title: Limitation
limitation.default: Exact recorded metadata only; not semantic vulnerability deduplication or verified remediation

notice.title: Notice
notice.default: Illustrative sample amounts; no cloud account, provider request or recorded spending.

report.title: Report
report.description: Operational scan snapshot. stage and progress (0-100) describe phase completion, not elapsed time; completed_steps records finished phases. Progress reaches 100 only with durable completed status. Error text is sanitized; no credentials or source content are returned.

scope.title: Scope
scope.default: MESH account sessions; provider refresh sessions are not revoked by this operation
